environment: STAGING restored native PostgreSQL, real Edge OAuth and official MCP client

cases.name: Unauthenticated MCP is closed; OAuth discovery advertises PKCE and the canonical audience
Actual Edge Admin consent returns a valid OAuth callback with state and issuer identification (callback captured by QA)
Wrong PKCE verifier is rejected and authorization codes are single use
Official MCP client initializes, lists all tools, and sees accurate read/write annotations
Capability discovery includes live debt data and native write contracts
Business tables are readable with working pagination; credential tables and password columns are excluded
MCP reads the exact native receivables and stock views used by the website
Provider settings are available without leaking the Brevo API key
Foreign browser origins are rejected even when a bearer token is supplied
STAGING native create/edit works, retries return the original result, conflicting retries and stale versions are rejected
Read tools cannot mutate; arbitrary URLs are never dispatched
Admin MCP uploads and reads the exact original document bytes through native validation
Refresh credentials rotate and used refresh tokens cannot be reused
MCP can read and revoke its own connection through native Admin management, immediately disabling OAuth access
Admin management shows connection history and revocation state on desktop and phones
